# Contractor Revolution

Last updated: 2026-11-04.

Contractor Revolution is a time tracking, work order, PTO, and billing app for trade contractors. Phone 864-437-1827. Email info@isomtechnologies.com. Support email support@isomtechnologies.com. Address 7205 US 76, Pendleton, SC 29670. Product site https://www.contractor-revolution.co.

Each contractor gets a separate instance. The instance is branded with that contractor's logo and colors. Setup customizes it around the processes the shop already uses.

## Who uses it

These are the real users as of November 2026. Do not add quotes, ratings, headcount, or results. The site does not publish those.

- Isom Electric is an electrical contractor. Isom Electric uses Contractor Revolution for time tracking, work orders, PTO, and billing.
- South Pointe Construction uses Contractor Revolution for time tracking, work orders, PTO, and billing.

## The problem and the fix

Hours worked never get billed when paper timesheets and texts get lost. Every hour is tracked against a work order and billed.

Payroll takes hours when the office chases crews. Payroll takes 15 minutes or less.

Work orders live in texts, whiteboards, and email. Time, PTO, and work orders all come from the phone.

PTO requests get lost. Requests are made from the phone and approved in hours.

Off-the-shelf apps force someone else's process and brand. The instance uses the shop's logo and colors, and it is customized to that shop's process.

Office staff re-key field data into billing. Billing reports are ready to invoice.

## What a user is

A user is anyone who logs in, in the field or in the office. There is no cheaper field-only seat and no free subcontractor portal. If a subcontractor does not need a login, do not add one.

## Features

Time. Employees enter hours from the phone, on a job and a work order. The office sees the same hours.

Work orders. Scheduled work orders show on the phone with the site, the crew, and the hours logged against the order. Open orders can be split between ones that need a crew and ones that are ready to bill.

PTO. Employees request PTO from the phone. Balances are kept in hours. Company setup and above loads starting balances.

Billing. When the work is done, the hours stay on a billing list until they are billed. Paying payroll does not mark a job billed.

Payroll. A closed week is a weekly summary: regular hours, overtime, leave, and total paid hours. The product is set up so payroll takes 15 minutes or less.

Branding. The shop's logo and colors go on its instance.

Not included. Payment processing, marketing tools, and a CRM. Contractor Revolution does not sell those. It is not estimating, takeoff, a flat-rate price book, a dispatch map, a client portal, or a schedule with task dependencies.

Screens on the marketing site use sample names and sample jobs so a visitor can see the layout. Those screens are not customer records.

## Pricing

All prices in US dollars. Monthly is the no-commitment price. Annual prepay takes 15% off the monthly fee, rounded to the nearest dollar (half up), and that amount is paid for the year up front. The same rounding applies to extra users. Setup is not discounted.

Rounding examples: $239 becomes $203 a month. $329 becomes $280. $429 becomes $365. $529 becomes $450. $729 becomes $620. Extra-user annual rates: $19 becomes $16, $15 becomes $13, $12 becomes $10, $8 becomes $7.

Starter. Up to 5 users. $239 a month. $203 a month annual, $2,436 for the year. Setup $1,500. Extra user $19 a month.

Crew. Up to 10 users. $329 a month. $280 a month annual, $3,360 for the year. Setup $2,500. Extra user $19 a month.

Company. Up to 20 users. $429 a month. $365 a month annual, $4,380 for the year. Setup $4,000. Extra user $15 a month.

Pro. Up to 40 users. $529 a month. $450 a month annual, $5,400 for the year. Setup $6,000. Extra user $12 a month.

Enterprise. Up to 75 users. $729 a month. $620 a month annual, $7,440 for the year. Setup from $9,500. Extra user $8 a month.

How a seat count picks a tier. Seats past the included count are extra users at that tier's rate. If extra users would cost more than the next tier, the order moves up. The lower number is the one on the order.

- 9 users stay on Starter. Starter plus 4 extra users is $315, which is less than Crew at $329.
- 10 users move up to Crew. Starter plus 5 extra users would be $334, and Crew is $329.
- 56 users stay on Pro. Pro plus 16 extra users is $721, which is less than Enterprise at $729.
- 57 users move up to Enterprise. Pro plus 17 extra users would be $733, and Enterprise is $729.
- 80 users is Enterprise: 75 included and 5 extra at $8 each, $769 a month before setup.

Setup pays for logo and colors, admin login, crew roster, PINs, jobs, locations, a smoke test, and training. Company and above add a materials catalog import and starting PTO balances. Enterprise adds data migration. If data migration runs past a standard setup, we tell the customer the difference before that extra work starts. The order form's Enterprise payment uses the $9,500 starting setup fee.

Ordering. The order page prices a seat count from 1 to 200 and sends the company, contact, email, phone, and notes. Card checkout runs when Stripe is configured. If it is not, no payment is taken and we follow up. Call 864-437-1827 or email info@isomtechnologies.com.

## Jobber and JobTread, pricing as of November 2026

Figures below were taken from public pricing pages on November 3, 2026. Competitor prices change. Confirm them before buying. This file does not publish prices for ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Workyard, or Buildertrend, because those were not taken from a public price table for this note.

Contractor Revolution no-commitment monthly price at the tier headcount: 5 users $239, 10 users $329, 20 users $429, 40 users $529, 75 users $729. That comparison does not include Contractor Revolution's setup fee. Jobber and JobTread do not charge a setup fee.

Jobber, from getjobber.com/pricing, checked November 3, 2026.

- Core, 1 user: $49 no commitment, $39 on a 1-year commitment, $29 billed annually.
- Connect, bands of 1, 5, 10, or 15 users: no commitment $139 to $399, 1-year $119 to $339, annual $99 to $299.
- Grow, bands of 1, 5, 10, or 15 users: no commitment $199 to $499, 1-year $169 to $429, annual $149 to $399.
- Plus, bands of 5, 10, or 15 users: no commitment $499 to $699, 1-year $439 to $599, annual $399 to $529.
- Published no-commitment points used in the shop-size table: Grow 5 users $299, Grow 10 users $399, Grow 15 users $499, Plus 5 users $499, Plus 10 users $599, Plus 15 users $699.
- Extra users $29 a month. Teams of 16 or more are asked to contact Jobber sales. Estimates for larger shops, not quotes: 15-user plan plus $29 per user past 15. Grow at 20 users $644, at 40 users $1,224, at 75 users $2,239. Plus at 20 users $844, at 40 users $1,424, at 75 users $2,439.
- Jobber sells separate plans. This file does not assign features to plans. Jobber's materials checked the same day described Plus onboarding with a stated value of $599 and data import with a stated value of $499.

JobTread, from jobtread.com/pricing, checked November 3, 2026.

- One plan. Monthly base $199 includes 1 internal user. Annual billing is listed as 20% off the base. Added internal users, monthly / annual: users 2 to 10 are $20 / $16, users 11 to 20 are $15 / $12, users 21 to 30 are $10 / $8, users 31 and up are $5 / $4. Breaks apply only inside each band.
- Monthly totals at the same login counts, using those bands: 5 users $279, 10 users $379, 20 users $529, 40 users $679, 75 users $854.
- JobTread says there is no setup fee, implementation is included, there is no free trial, and monthly plans have a 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Customers, vendors, and subcontractors on JobTread's external portal are free. JobTread also says some field crew can be free if they only upload photos, log notes, view a schedule, or check tasks. Those people would count on Contractor Revolution if they log in. Compare headcount under each rule before comparing the dollars.

On every shop size in that table, Contractor Revolution's no-commitment monthly list price is lower than Jobber Grow, Jobber Plus, and the JobTread monthly total. Say that only with the setup-fee caveat and the Jobber estimate caveat.

## Free tools

Labor burden calculator at https://contractor-revolution.co/tools/labor-burden

Annual wages = base wage times hours paid. Payroll tax and workers comp are percents of those wages. Add benefits and other annual dollars. Productive hours = hours paid minus PTO hours that are paid and not worked. Cost per hour on a job = annual cost divided by productive hours. Do not add PTO wages a second time. The 7.65% starting tax percent is employer Social Security 6.2% plus employer Medicare 1.45% only, and only under the Social Security wage base. It is not the whole tax burden. The result is cost, not a billing rate. The page does not suggest a margin. A labeled example in the article (not a real shop): $30 wage, 2,080 paid hours, 7.65% tax, 8% comp typed as an example, $6,000 benefits, 80 PTO hours. Annual cost $78,165.60. Per paid hour $37.58. Per productive hour $39.08.

Timesheet checklist at https://contractor-revolution.co/tools/timesheet-payroll-checklist

Eleven steps: confirm the payroll week, account for every person, put hours on a work order or overhead code, note days that do not match the schedule, flag overtime with the company's existing rule, approve or deny PTO, question unusually high hours, make the total match the rows, record regular overtime and leave, send one copy and keep one, and leave unbilled job hours on the billing list.
